text: Didn’t Catch a Single Fly. Save yourself the trouble.

product_metadata.title: RSVP Endurance Kitchen Collection Ceramic Fruit Fly Trap, Stainless Steel Lid, Dishwasher Safe, 3.25x2.5
features: SIZE: Measures 3.25" in diameter and 2.5" tall
PRACTICAL DESIGN: Keep bothersome fruit flies at bay with this easy to use trap; Simply fill the cup with an apple cider vinegar mixture and flies are lured through the perforated Stainless Steel top
FOR YOUR KITCHEN: For best results, place this attractive trap near fruit on the counter to keep produce healthy and bug free; Empty the cup often and repeat with the enclosed recipe
QUALITY MATERIALS: Made of durable ceramic and 18/8 Stainless Steel
description: RSVP strives to offer quality kitchen products and cooking tools at competitive prices. When all the right people, ingredients, kitchen tools, and food come together, we call this The Art of Gathering.
